description:
SGP is seeking experienced Capture Managers to lead federal pursuits from qualification through proposal handoff. You will shape opportunities, develop competitive win strategies, and position clients for success while collaborating with client executives, business development (BD) leads, and proposal teams.

You'll bring experience working successfully as a 1099 consultant and be comfortable supporting multiple clients, each with distinct markets, organizational maturity levels, processes, and tools. You'll also have a demonstrated ability to collaborate with capture coordinators, proposal managers, writers, editors, graphic designers, and pricing and contracts professionals to ensure capture strategies and win themes are effectively integrated into proposal development.

Workplace Type: Remote.

Compensation: 1099 Consultant. $120–$140 per hour.

Security Clearance: Active Security Clearance. (not required for most engagements)

Why Join the SGP Capture & Proposals Team

As an SGP consultant, you’ll retain the independence of contract work while accessing a collaborative network of resources to support successful engagements.

  • Select consultant network: Join a network of experienced capture and proposal professionals who have diverse expertise and collaborate to support client needs across a variety of engagements.

  • The right fit, by design: We strive to align each consultant with client engagements that complement their professional expertise, career interests, and working styles, creating opportunities for meaningful contributions and successful collaboration.

  • Referral bonuses: Earn referral incentives for introducing prospective clients and qualified consultants to the SGP network, subject to program eligibility requirements.

  • Resources that raise the bar: Access optional professional development opportunities, established templates, industry best practices, and support from experienced professionals to strengthen the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • Flexibility and choice: Enjoy the flexibility of remote consulting and the opportunity to accept engagements that align with your availability, expertise, and professional interests.

  • Modern, AI-enabled workflows: Collaborate with a team that combines extensive federal contracting expertise with modern technologies and evolving AI-assisted tools and processes to support efficient, high-quality proposal development.

  • Breadth of experience: Gain exposure to a variety of federal agencies, contract vehicles, and clients, ranging from emerging small businesses to established government contractors.

  • A path to grow: Collaborate with experienced capture managers and gain exposure to capture planning, research, and strategic activities, with opportunities to expand your responsibilities as your experience develops.

Responsibilities

  • Lead opportunity qualification activities and develop bid/no-bid recommendations through structured gate reviews.

  • Develop capture plans encompassing customer intelligence, competitive analysis, solution strategy, and teaming approaches.

  • Conduct competitive assessments, incumbent analyses, and black hat reviews to strengthen win strategies.

  • Develop win themes, discriminators, and ghosting strategies informed by customer insights.

  • Identify potential teaming partners and support negotiations, teaming agreements, and workshare planning in coordination with client contracts teams.

  • Coordinate customer engagement strategies and help shape requirements early through RFIs, sources sought responses, and industry day participation.

  • Support price-to-win analysis and pricing strategy development in collaboration with pricing leads.

  • Transition capture strategies to the proposal team and support proposal reviews through submission.

  • Maintain pipeline data, capture plans, and status reports in each client's CRM and tracking tools.

  • Guide Capture Coordinators supporting assigned pursuits, including delegating research, tracking, and data management tasks.

Required Qualifications

  • At least seven years of experience in federal business development or capture management.

  • Demonstrated track record of successful competitive federal contract pursuits, with the ability to discuss relevant contract awards.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent pursuits across different clients and deadlines.

  • Comprehensive understanding of the federal acquisition lifecycle, contract types, and procurement vehicles (IDIQ, GWAC, GSA MAS, BPA).

  • Experience with industry proven structured capture processes.

  • Strong executive-level communication and client-facing skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Agency-specific customer relationships or domain expertise in areas such as DoD services and combatant commands, DHS, VA and civilian health, IT modernization, or federal construction.

  • Experience supporting small-business set-aside pursuits and strategies, including 8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, or HUBZone programs.

  • Experience with price-to-win analysis or competitive intelligence.

  • Experience with Other Transaction Authority (OTA), SBIR/STTR, or other nontraditional acquisition pathways.

  • Experience with GovWin, GovSignal, HigherGov, GovTribe, Salesforce, or similar opportunity intelligence and CRM platforms.

  • APMP certification.

  • Active security clearance (not required for most engagements).
